verses.text: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara ojiṣṭhaṃ pupuri śravaḥ | yaddidhṛkṣema vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra paprāḥ ||
indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhikṣamā viśvarūpaṃ yadasya | tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codadrādha upastutaṃ cidarvāk ||
yasyedamā rajoyujastuje jane vanaṃ svaḥ | indrasya rantyaṃ bṛhat ||
uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya | athāditya vrate vayaṃ tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||
tvayā vayaṃ pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
imaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ kṛṇutaikaminmām ||
sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | varivovitparisrava ||
enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām | siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya pūrvaṃ devebhyo amṛtasya nāma | yo mā dadāti sa idevamāvadahamannamannamadantamadmi ||
tvametadadhārayaḥ kṛṣṇāsu rohiṇīṣu ca | paruṣṇīṣu ruśatpayaḥ ||
arūrucaduṣasaḥ pṛśniragriya ukṣā mimeti bhuvaneṣu vājayuḥ | māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbhamādadhuḥ ||
indra iddharyoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā | indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ ||
indra vājeṣu no 'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca | ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ ||
prathaśca yasya saprathaśca nāmānuṣṭubhasya haviṣo haviryat | dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇo rathantaramā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
niyutvānvāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te | gantāsi sunvato gṛham ||
yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya | tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uto divam ||
mayi varco atho yaśo 'tho yajñasya yatpayaḥ | parameṣṭhī prajāpatirdivi dyāmiva dṛṃhatu ||
saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva ||
tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ | tvamātanorurvā3ntarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha ||
agnimīḍe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam | hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
te manvata prathamaṃ nāma gonāṃ triḥ sapta paramaṃ nāma janān | tā jānatīrabhyanūṣata kṣā āvirbhuvannaruṇīryaśasā gāvaḥ ||
samanyā yantyupayantyanyāḥ samānamūrvaṃ nadyaspṛṇanti | tamū śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsamapānnapātamupa yantyāpaḥ ||
ā prāgādbhadrā yuvatirahnaḥ ketūntsamīrtsati | abhūdbhadrā niveśanī viśvasya jagato rātrī ||
prakṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū mahaḥ pra no vaco vidathā jātavedase | vaiśvānarāya matirnavyase śuciḥ soma iva pavate cāruragnaye ||
viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñamubhe rodasī apāṃ napācca manma | mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣvidvo antamā madema ||
yaśo mā dyāvāpṛthivī yaśo mendrabṛhaspatī | yaśo bhagasya vindatu yaśo mā pratimucyatām | yaśasvyā3syāḥ saṃ sado 'haṃ pravaditā syām ||
indrasya nu vīryāṇi pravocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī | ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinatparvatānām ||
agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan | tridhāturarko rajaso vimāno 'jasraṃ jyotirhavirasmi sarvam ||
pātyagnirvipo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ pāti yahvaścaraṇaṃ sūryasya | pāti nābhā saptaśīrṣāṇamagniḥ ||
bhrājantyagne samidhāna dīdivo jihvā caratyantarāsani | sa tvaṃ no agne payasā vasuvidrayiṃ varco dṛśe 'dāḥ ||
vasanta innu rantyo grīṣma innu rantyaḥ | varṣāṇyanu śarado hemantaḥ śiśira innu rantyaḥ ||
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt | sa bhūmiṃ sarvato vṛtvātyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||
tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pado 'syehābhavatpunaḥ | tathā viṣvaṅ vyakrāmadaśanānaśane abhi ||
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam | pādo 'sya sarvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||
tāvānasya mahimā tato jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ | utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati ||
tato virāḍajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ | sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ ||
manye vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau ye aprathethāmamitamabhi yojanam | dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ syone te no muñcatamaṃhasaḥ ||
harī ta indra śmaśrūṇyuto te haritau hari | taṃ tvā stuvanti kavayaḥ puruṣāso vanargavaḥ ||
yadvarco hiraṇyasya yadvā varco gavāmuta | satyasya brahmaṇo varcastena mā saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
sahastanna indra daddhyoja īśe hyasya mahato virapśin | kratuṃ na nṛmṇaṃ sthaviraṃ ca vājaṃ vṛtreṣu śatrūntsuhanā kṛdhī naḥ ||
saharṣabhāḥ sahavatsā udeta viśvā rūpāṇī bibhratīrdvyūdnīḥ | uruḥ pṛthurayaṃ vo astu loka imā āpaḥ suprapāṇā iha sta ||
agna āyūṃṣi pavasa āsuvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
vibhrāṅbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam | vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudhā vi rājati ||
citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca ||
āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ ||
antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī | vyakhyanmahiṣo divam ||
triṃṣaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṅgāya dhīyate | prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ ||
apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ | sūrāya viśvacakṣase ||
adṛśrannasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu | bhrājanto agnayo yathā ||
taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya | viśvamābhāsi rocanam ||
pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣān | pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svardṛśe ||
yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu | tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||
uddyāmeṣi rajaḥ pṛthvahā mimāno aktubhiḥ | paśyañjanmāni sūrya ||
ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptryaḥ | tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ ||
sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya | śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa ||
vidā maghavan vidā gātumanuśaṃsiṣo diśaḥ | śikṣā śacīnāṃ pate pūrvīṇāṃ purūvaso ||
ābhiṣṭvamabhiṣṭibhiḥ svā '3rnnāṃśuḥ | pracetana pracetayendra dyumnāya na iṣe ||
evā hi śakro rāye vājāya vajrivaḥ | śaviṣṭha vajrinnṛñjase maṃhiṣṭha vajrinnṛñjasa | ā yāhi piba matsva ||
vidā rāye suvīryaṃ bhavo vājānāṃ patirvaśāṃ anu | maṃhiṣṭha vajrinnṛñjase yaḥ śaviṣṭhaḥ śūrāṇām ||
yo maṃhiṣṭho maghonāmṃśurnna śociḥ | cikitvo abhi no nayeṃdro vide tamu stuhi ||
īśe hi śakrastamūtaye havāmahe jetāramaparājitam | sa naḥ svarṣadati dviṣaḥ kratuśchanda ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
indraṃ dhanasya sātaye havāmahe jetāramaparājitam | sa naḥ svarṣadati dviṣaḥ sa naḥ svarṣadati dviṣaḥ ||
pūrvasya yatte adrivoṃ 'śurmadāya | sumna ā dhehi no vaso pūrtiḥ śaviṣṭha śasyate | vaśī hi śakro nūnaṃ tannavyaṃ saṃnyase ||
prabho janasya vṛtrahantsamaryeṣu bravāvahai | śūro yo goṣu gacchati sakhā suśevo advayuḥ ||

devebhirmānuṣe jane ||
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam | asya yajñasya sukratum ||
agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ stuṣe mitramiva priyam | agne rathaṃ na vedyam ||
tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ pāhi viśvasyā arāteḥ | uta dviṣo martyasya ||
ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna itthetarā giraḥ | ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ ||
ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt | agne tvāṃ kāmaye girā ||
tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||
agne vivasvadā bharāsmabhyamūtaye mahe | devo hyasi no dṛśe ||
namaste agna ojase gṛṇanti deva kṛṣṭayaḥ | amairamitramardaya ||
dūtaṃ vo viśvavedasaṃ havyavāhamamartyam | yajiṣṭhamṛñjase girā ||
upa tvā jāmayo giro dediśatīrhaviṣkṛtaḥ | vāyoranīke asthiran ||
upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam | namo bharanta emasi ||
jarābodha tadviviḍḍhi viśeviśe yajñiyāya | stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam ||
prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhiragna ā gahi ||
aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ | samrājantamadhvarāṇām ||
aurvabhṛguvacchucimapnavānavadā huve | agniṃ samudravāsasam ||
agnimindhāno manasā dhiyaṃ saceta martyaḥ | agnimindhe vivasvabhiḥ ||
āditpratnasya retaso jyotiḥ paśyanti vāsaram | paro yadidhyate divi ||
agniṃ vo vṛdhantamadhvarāṇāṃ purūtamam | acchā naptre sahasvate ||
agnistigmena śociṣā yaṃsadviśvaṃ nyā3triṇam | agnirno vaṃsate rayim ||
agne mṛḍa mahāṃ asyaya ā devayuṃ janam | iyetha barhirāsadam ||
agne rakṣā ṇo aṃhasaḥ prati sma deva rīṣataḥ | tapiṣṭhairajaro daha ||
agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ | araṃ vahantyāśavaḥ ||
ni tvā nakṣya viśpate dyumantaṃ dhīmahe vayam | suvīramagna āhuta ||
agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati ||
imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam | agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ ||
taṃ tvā gopavano girā janiṣṭhadagne aṅgaraḥ | sa pāvaka śrudhī havam ||
pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||
udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam ||
kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmāṇamadhvare | devamamīvacātanam ||
śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaye śaṃ no bhavantu pītaye | śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ ||
kasya nūnaṃ parīṇasi dhiyo jinvasi satpate | joṣātā yasya te giraḥ ||
yajñāyajñā vo agnaye girāgirā ca dakṣase | prapra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ||
pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyū3ta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso ||
bṛhadbhiragne arcibhiḥ śukreṇa deva śociṣā | bharadvāje samidhāno yaviṣṭhya revatpāvaka dīdihi ||
tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ | yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvaṃ dayanta gonām ||
agne jaritarviśpatistapāno deva rakṣasaḥ | aproṣivāngṛhapate mahāṃ asi divaspāyurduroṇayuḥ ||
agne vivasvaduṣasaścitraṃ rādho amartya | ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ ||
tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā vaso rādhāṃsi codaya | asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ ||
tvamitsaprathā asyagne trātarṛtaḥ kaviḥ | tvāṃ viprāsaḥ samidhāna dīdiva ā vivāsanti vedhasaḥ ||
ā no agne vayovṛdhaṃ rayiṃ pāvaka śaṃsyam | rāsvā ca na upamāte puruspṛhaṃ sunītī suyaśastaram ||
yo viśvā dayate vasu hotā mandro janānām | madhorna pātrā prathamānyasmai pra stomā yantvagnaye ||
enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve | priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ svādhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam ||
śeṣe vaneṣu mātṛṣu saṃ tvā martāsa indhate | atandro havyaṃ vahasi haviṣkṛta ādiddeveṣu rājasi ||
adarśi gātuvittamo yasminvratānyādadhuḥ | upo ṣu jātamāryasya vardhanamagniṃ nakṣantu no giraḥ ||
agnirukthe purohito grāvāṇo barhiradhvare | ṛcā yāmi maruto brahmaṇaspate devā avo vareṇyam ||
agnimīḍiṣvāvase gāthābhiḥ śīraśociṣam | agniṃ rāye purumīḍha śrutaṃ naro 'gniḥ sudītaye chardiḥ ||
śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ | ā sīdatu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvabhiradhvare ||
pra daivodāso agnirdeva indro na majmanā | anu mātaraṃ pṛthivīṃ vi vāvṛte tasthau nākasya śarmaṇi ||
adha jmo adha vā divo bṛhato rocanādadhi | ayā vardhasva tanvā girā mamā jātā sukrato pṛṇa ||
kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yanmātR^īrajagannapaḥ | na tatte agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yaddūre sannihābhuvaḥ ||
ni tvāmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanāya śaśvate | dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭvāsicam | udvā siñjadhvamupa vā pṛṇadhvamādidvo deva ohate ||
praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā | acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||
ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā | ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe ||
pra yo rāye ninīṣati marto yaste vaso dāśat | sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśaṃsinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam ||
pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām | agniṃ sūktebhirvacobhirvṛṇīmahe yaṃsamidanya indhate ||
ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe hi saubhagasya | rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām ||
tvamagne gṛhapatistvaṃ hotā no adhvare | tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā tākṣi yāsi ca vāryam ||
sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye | apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudaṃsasaṃ supratūrtimanehasam ||
ā juhotā haviṣā marjayadhvaṃ ni hotāraṃ gṛhapatiṃ dadhidhvam | iḍaspade namasā rātahavyaṃ saparyatā yajataṃ pastyānām ||
citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvanveti dhātave | anūdhā yadajījanadadhā cidā vavakṣatsadyo mahi dūtyā3ṃ caran ||
idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva | saṃveśanastanve3 cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre ||
imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā | bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim | kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannāḥ pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhādukthebhiragne janayanta devāḥ | taṃ tvā giraḥ suṣṭutayo vājayantyājiṃ na girvavāho jigyuraśvāḥ ||

indhe rājā samaryo namobhiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ ghṛtena | naro havyebhirīḍate sabādha āgniragramuṣasāmaśoci ||
pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti | divaścidantādupamāmudānaḍapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha ||

pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadmā sīdadapāṃ vivarte | dadhadyo dhāyī sute vayāṃsi yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ ||
pra samrājamasurasya praśstaṃ puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnāmanumādyasya | indrasyeva pra tavasaskṛtāni vandadvārā vandamānā vivaṣṭu ||

sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ | anu daha sahamūrānkayādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ ||
agna ojiṣṭhamā bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo | pra no rāye panīyase ratsi vājāya panthām ||
yadi vīro anu ṣyādagnimindhīta martyaḥ | ājuhvaddhavyamānuṣakśarma bhakṣīta daivyam ||
tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi saṃ cchukra ātataḥ | sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase ||
tvaṃ hi kṣaitavadyaśo 'gne mitro na patyase | tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi ||
prātaragniḥ purupriyo viṣa stavetātithiḥ | viśve yasminnamartye havyaṃ martāsa indhate ||
yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso | mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate ||

yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtaye vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi ||

baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ asi | mahaste sato mahimā paniṣṭama mahnā deva mahāṃ asi ||

yaddyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ | na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī ||
yadindra prāgapāgudagnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ | simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave 'si praśardha turvaśe ||
kastamindra tvā vasavā martyo dadharṣati | śraddhā hi te maghavanpārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati ||
indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgātpadvatībhyaḥ | hitvā śiro jihvayā rārapaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt ||
indra nedīya edihi mitamedhābhirūtibhiḥ | ā śaṃ tama śaṃ tamābhirabhiṣṭibhirā svāpe svāpibhiḥ ||
ita ūtī vo ajaraṃ prahetāramaprahitam | āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamamatūrtaṃ tugriyāvṛdham ||
mo ṣu tvā vāghataśca nāre asmanni rīraman | ārāttādvā sadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi ||

śacībhirnaḥ śacīvasū divānaktaṃ diśasyatam | mā vāṃ rātirupa dasatkadā ca nāsmadrātiḥ kadā ca na ||
yadā kadā ca mīḍhuṣe stotā jareta martyaḥ | ādidvandeta varuṇaṃ vipā girā dharttāraṃ vivratānām ||
pāhi gā andhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe | yaḥ sammiślo haryoryo hiraṇyaya indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ ||
ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ | satrācyā maghavāntsomapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat ||
mahe ca na tvādrivaḥ parā śulkāya dīyase | na sahasrāya nāyutāye vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha ||
vasyāṃ indrāsi me pituruta bhrāturabhuñjataḥ | mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase ||
ima indrāya sunvire somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | tāṃ ā madāya vajrahasta pītaye haribhyāṃ yāhyoka ā ||
ima indra madāya te somāścikitra ukithanaḥ | madhoḥ papāna upa no giraḥ śṛṇu rāsva stotrāya girvaṇaḥ ||
ā tvā3dya sabardughāṃ huve gāyatravepasam | indraṃ dhenuṃ sudughāmanyāmiṣamurudhārāmaraṅkṛtam ||
na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīḍavaḥ | yacchikṣasi stuvate māvate vasu na kiṣṭadā mināti te ||
ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadhe | ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinatyojasā mandānaḥ śipryandhasaḥ ||
yadindra śāso avrataṃ cyāvayā sadasaspari | asmākamaṃśuṃ maghavanpuruspṛhaṃ vasavye adhi barhaya ||
tvaṣṭā no daivyaṃ vacaḥ parjanyo brahmaṇaspatiḥ | putrairbhrātṛbhiraditirnu pātu no duṣṭaraṃ trāmaṇaṃ vacaḥ ||
kadā ca na starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe | upopennu maghavanbhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyate ||
yuṅkṣvā hi vṛtrahantama harī indra parāvataḥ | arvācīno maghavantsomapītaya ugra ṛṣvebhirā gahi ||
tvāmidā hyo naro 'pīpyanvajrinbhūrṇayaḥ | sa indra stomavāhasa iha śrudhyupa svasaramā gahi ||
pratyu adarśyāyatyū3cchantī duhitā divaḥ | apo mahī vṛṇute cakṣuṣā tamo jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnari ||

ā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācannahaṃ jyā | bhūrṇiṃ mṛgaṃ na savaneṣu cukrudhaṃ ka īśānaṃ na yāciṣat ||

asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkamandho nyasminnindro januṣemuvoca | bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñairbodhā na stomamandhaso madeṣu ||

vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra | devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna ||
tvaṃ ha tyatsaptabhyo jāyamāno 'śatrubhyo abhavaḥ śatrurindra | gūḍhe dyāvāpṛthivī anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raṇaṃ dhāḥ ||
meḍiṃ na tvā vajriṇaṃ bhṛṣṭimantaṃ purudhasmānaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ sthirapsnum | karoṣyaryastaruṣīrduvasyurindra dyukṣaṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe ||

udu brahmāṇyairata śravasyendraṃ samarye mahayā vasiṣṭha | ā yo viśvāni śravasā tatānopaśrotā ma īvato vacāṃsi ||
cakraṃ yadasyāpsvā niṣattamuto tadasmai madhviccacchadyāt | pṛthivyāmatiṣitaṃ yadūdhaḥ payo goṣvadadhā oṣadhīṣu ||

yo no vanuṣyannabhidāti marta ugaṇā vā manyamānasturo vā | kṣidhī yudhā śavasā vā tamindrābhī ṣyāma vṛṣamaṇastvotāḥ ||
yaṃ vṛtreṣu kṣitaya spardhamānā yaṃ yukteṣu turayanto havante | yaṃ śūrasātau yamapāmupajmanyaṃ viprāso vājayante sa indraḥ ||

śrudī havaṃ tiraścyā indra yastvā saparyati | suvīryasya gomato rāyaspūrdhi mahāṃ asi ||
asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi | ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ ||
endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
ā tvā giro rathīrivāsthuḥ suteṣu girvaṇaḥ | abhi tvā samanūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ ||

sa pūrvyo mahonāṃ venaḥ kratubhirānaje | yasya dvārā manuḥ pitā deveṣu dhiya ānaje ||
yadī vahantyāśavo bhrājamānā ratheṣvā | pibanto madiraṃ madhu tatra śravāṃsi kṛṇvate ||
tyamu vo aprahaṇaṃ gṛṇīṣe śavasaspatim | indraṃ viśvāsāhaṃ naraṃ śaciṣṭhaṃ viśvavedasam ||
dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatpra na āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
purāṃ bhinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata | indro viśvasya karmaṇo dharttā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ ||
prapra vastriṣṭubhamiṣaṃ vandadvīrāyendave | dhiyā vo medhasātaye purandhyā vivāsati ||
kaśyapasya svarvido yāvāhuḥ sayujāviti | yayorviśvamapi vrataṃ yajñaṃ dhīrā nicāyya ||
arcata prārcatā naraḥ priyamedhāso arcata | arcantu putrakā uta puramiddhṛṣṇvarcata ||
ukthamindrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanaṃ puruniḥṣidhe | śakro yathā suteṣu no rāraṇatsakhyeṣu ca ||
viśvānarasya vaspatimanānatasya śavasaḥ | evaiśca carṣaṇīnāmūtī huve rathānām ||
sa ghā yaste divo naro dhiyā martasya śamataḥ | ūtī sa bṛhato divo dviṣo aṃho na tarati ||
vibhoṣṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato | athā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnaṃ sudatra maṃhaya ||
vayaścitte patatriṇo dvipāccatuṣpādarjuni | uṣaḥ prārannṛtūṃranu divo antebhyaspari ||
amī ye devā sthana madhya ā rocane divaḥ | kadva ṛtaṃ kadamṛtaṃ kā pratnā va āhutiḥ ||

ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati | yenā haṃsi nyā3triṇaṃ tamīmahe ||
tuce tunāya tatsu no drādhīya āyurjīvase | ādityāsaḥ samahasaḥ kṛṇotana ||
vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam | aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva ||
apāmīvāmapa stridhamapa sedhata durmatim | ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ ||
pibā somamindra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ | soturbāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā ||
abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi | yudhedāpitvamicchase ||
yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu va stuṣe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||

tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi | saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ ||
gāvaściddhā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ | rihate kakubho mithaḥ ||
tvaṃ na indrā bhara ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe | ā vīraṃ pṛtanāsaham ||
adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāma īmahe sasṛgmahe | udeva gmanta udabhiḥ ||
sīdantaste vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe | abhi tvāmindra nonumaḥ ||
vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccidbharanto 'vasyavaḥ | vajriñcitraṃ havāmahe ||
svādoritthā viṣūvato madhoḥ pibanti gauryaḥ | yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhathā vasvīranu svarājyam ||
itthā hi soma inmado brahma cakāra vardhanam | śaviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahimarcannanu svarājyam ||
indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ | taminmahatsvājiṣūtimarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no 'viṣat ||
indra tubhyamidadrivo 'nuttaṃ vajrinvīryam | yaddha tyaṃ māyinaṃ mṛgaṃ tava tyanmāyayāvadhīrarcannanu svarājyam ||
prehyabhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate | indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo 'rcannanu svarājyam ||
yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanam | yuṅkṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho 'smāṃ indra vasau dadhaḥ ||
akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata | astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī ||
upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavanmātathā iva | kadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara idarthayāsa idyojā nvindra te harī ||
candramā apsvā3ntarā suparṇo dhāvate divi | na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī ||
prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam | stotā vāmaśvināvṛśi stomebhirbhūṣati prati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
ā te agna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram | yuddha syā te panīyasī samiddīdayati dyavīṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
āgniṃ na svavṛktibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe | śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vi vo made yajñeṣu stīrṇabarhiṣaṃ vivakṣase ||
mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī | yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum | athā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇā gāvo na yavase vivakṣase ||
kratvā mahāṃ anuṣvadhaṃ bhīma ā vāvṛte śavaḥ | śriya ṛṣva upākayorni śiprī harivāṃ dadhe hastayorvajramāyasam ||
sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam | yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindrā ciketati yojā nvindra te harī ||
agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ | astamarvanta āśavo 'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam | sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayati varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ ||
pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādurmitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya ||
paryū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ | dviṣastaradhyā ṛṇayā na īrase ||
pavasva soma mahāntsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma ||
pavasva soma mahe dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya ||
induḥ paviṣṭa cārurmadāyāpāmupasthe kavirbhagāya ||
anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye | vājāṃ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase ||
ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḍā rudrasya maryā atha svaśvāḥ ||
agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam | ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ ||
āvirmaryā ā vājaṃ vājino agmaṃ devasya savituḥ savam | svargāṃ arvanto jayata ||
pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahāṃ avīnāmanupūrvyaḥ ||
viśvatodāvanviśvato na ā bhara yaṃ tvā śaviṣṭhamīmahe ||
eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviya indro nāma śruto gṛṇe ||
brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u ||
anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣustvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam ||
śaṃ padaṃ maghaṃ rayīṣiṇo na kāmamavrato hinoti na spṛśadrayim ||
sadā gāvaḥ śucayo viśvadhāyasaḥ sadā devā arepasaḥ ||
ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta varttaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ ||
upa prakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayiṃ dhīmahe ta indra ||
arcantyarkaṃ marutaḥ svarkkā ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ ||
pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprāya gāthaṃ gāyata yaṃ jujoṣate ||
acetyagniścikitirhavyavāḍna sumadrathaḥ ||
agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhuvo varūthyaḥ ||
bhago na citro agnirmahonāṃ dadhāti ratnam ||
viśvasya pra stobha puro vā sanyadi veha nūnam ||
uṣā apa svasuṣṭamaḥ saṃ varttayati varttaniṃ sujātatā ||
imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhemendraśca viśve ca devāḥ ||
vi srutayo yathā patha indra tvadyantu rātayaḥ ||
ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
ūrjā mitro varuṇaḥ pinvateḍāḥ pīvarīmiṣaṃ kṛṇuhī na indra ||
indro viśvasya rājati ||
trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛmpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśam | sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma karttave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram ||
ayaṃ sahasramānavo dṛśaḥ kavīnāṃ matirjyotirvidharma | bradhnaḥ samīcīruṣasaḥ samairayadarepasaḥ socetasaḥ svasare manyumantaścitā goḥ ||
endra yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastā rājeva satpatiḥ | havāmahe tvā prayasvantaḥ suteṣvā putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye ||
tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śravāṃsi bhūriḥ | maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartta rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī ||
astu śrauṣṭpuro agniṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tyacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe | yaddha krāṇā vivasvate nābhā sandāya navyase | adha pra nūnamupa yanti dhītayo devāṃacchā na dhītayaḥ ||
pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut | pra śardhāya pra yajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase ||
ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati sayugvabhiḥ sūro na sayugvabhiḥ | dhārā pṛṣṭhasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ | viśvā yadrūpā pariyāsyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhirṛkvabhiḥ ||
abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matim ūrdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutatsavīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpā svaḥ ||
agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasoḥ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam | ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā | ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ ||
tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto 'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam | yo devasya śavasā prāriṇā asu riṇannapaḥ | bhuvo viśvamabhyadevamojasā videdūrjaṃ śatakraturvidediṣam ||
uccā te jātamandhaso divi sadbhūmyā dade | ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ ||
svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||
vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ | viśvā dadhāna ojasā ||
yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā | devāvīraghaśaṃsahā ||
tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ | harireti kanikradat ||
indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ | arkasya yonimāsadam ||
asāvyaṃśurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ | śyeno na yonimāsadat ||
pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare | marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ ||
pari svāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣarat | madeṣu sarvadhā asi ||
pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayāṃsi naptyorhitaḥ | svānairyāti kavikratuḥ ||
pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ | sutā vidathe akramuḥ ||
pra somāso vipaścito 'po nayanta ūrmayaḥ | vanāni mahiṣā iva ||
pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane | viśvā apa dviṣo jahi ||
vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe | pavamāna svardṛśam ||
induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matiḥ | sṛjadaśvaṃ rathīriva ||
asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā | śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ ||
pavasva deva āyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ | vāyumā roha dharmaṇā ||
pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum | jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat ||
pari svānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā | madho arṣanti dhārayā ||
pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ | kāruṃ bibhratpuruspṛham ||
upo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobhirbhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam | induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ ||
punāno akramīdabhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ | śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ ||
āviśankalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ | indurindrāya dhīyate ||
asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ | kārṣmanvājī nyakramīt ||
pra yadgāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ | ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇāmapa tvacam ||
apaghnanpavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ | nudasvādevayuṃ janam ||
ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ | hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ ||
sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave | vavrivāṃsaṃ mahīrapaḥ ||
ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā | avāhannavatīrnava ||
pari dyukṣaṃ sanadrāyiṃ bharadvājaṃ no andhasā | svāno arṣa pavitra ā ||
acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ | saṃ sūryeṇa didyute ||
ā te dakṣaṃ mayobhuvaṃ vahnimadyā vṛṇīmahe | pāntamā puruspṛham ||
adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā naya | punīhīndrāya pātave ||
taratsa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ | taratsa mandī dhāvati ||
ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam | asme śravāṃsi dhāraya ||
anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ | ruce jananta sūryam ||
arṣā soma dyumattamo 'bhi droṇāni roruvat | sīdanyonau yoneṣvā ||
vṛṣā soma dyumāṃ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ | vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhriṣe ||
iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ | indo rucābhi gā ihi ||
mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ | avyo vārebhirasmayuḥ ||
ayā soma sukṛtyapā mahāntsannabhyavardhathāḥ | hindāna idvṛṣāyase ||
ayaṃ vicarṣaṇirhitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati | hinvāna āpyaṃ bṛhat ||
pra ṇa indo mahe tu na ūrmiṃ na bibhradarṣasi | abhi devāṃ ayāsyaḥ ||
apaghnanpavate mṛdho 'pa somo arāvṇaḥ | gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam ||
punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi | ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasyutso devo hiraṇyayaḥ ||
parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ | dadhanvāṃ yo naryo apsvā3ntarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ ||
ā soma svāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā | jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhriṣe ||
pra soma devavītaye sindhurna pipye arṇasā | aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛviracchā kośaṃ madhuścutam ||
soma u ṣvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiradhi ṣṇubhiravīnām | aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā ||
tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo divedive | purūṇi babhro ni caranti māmava paridhīṃrati tāṃ ihi ||
mṛjyamānaḥ suhastyā samudre vācaminvasi | rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi ||
abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam | samudrasyādhi viṣṭape manīṣiṇo matsarāso madacyutaḥ ||
punānaḥ soma jāgṛviravyā vāraiḥ pari priyaḥ | tvaṃ vipro abhavo 'ṅgirastama madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣa ṇaḥ ||
indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ | sahasradhāro atyavyamarṣati tamī mṛjantyāyavaḥ ||
pavasva vājasātamo 'bhi viśvāni vāryā | tvaṃ samudraḥ prathame vidharmaṃ devebhyaṃ soma matsaraḥ ||
pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitramati dhārayā | marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhāmabhi prayāṃsi ca ||
pra tu drava pari kośaṃ ni ṣīda nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vājamarṣa | aśvaṃ na tvā vājinaṃ marjayanto 'cchā barhī raśanābhirnayanti ||
pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti | mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhyeti rebhan ||
tisro vāca īrayati pra vahnirṛtasya dhītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām | gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ ||
asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam | sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā ||
somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ | janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ ||
abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgoṣiṇamavāvaśanta vāṇīḥ | vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūrvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi ||
akrāntsamudraḥ prathame vidharmaṃ janayanprajā bhuvanasya gopāḥ | vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhatsomo vāvṛdhe svāno adriḥ ||
kanikranti harirā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdanvanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ | nṛbhiryataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gāmato matiṃ janayata svadhābhiḥ ||
eṣa sya te madhumāṃ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇaḥ pari pavitre akṣāḥ | sahasradāḥ śatadā bhūridāvā śaśvattamaṃ barhirā vājyasthāt ||
pavasva soma madhumāṃ ṛtāvāpo vasāno adhi sāno avye | ava droṇāni ghṛtavanti roha madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ ||
pra senānīḥ śūro agre rathānāṃ gavyanneti harṣate asya senā | bhadrānkṛṇvannindrahavāntsakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte ||
pra te dhārā madhumatīrasṛgranvāraṃ yatpūto atyeṣyavyam | pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ janayantsūryamapinvo arkaiḥ ||
pra gāyatābhyarcāma devāntsomaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya | svāduḥ pavatāmati vāramavyamā sīdatu kalaśaṃ deva induḥ ||
pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣannayāsīt | indraṃ gacchannāyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayorādadhānaḥ ||
takṣadyadī manaso venato vāgjyeṣṭhasya dharmaṃ dyukṣoranīke | ādīmāyanvaramā vāvaśānā juṣṭaṃ patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum ||
sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ | hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī ||
adhi yadasminvājinīva śubhaḥ spardhante dhiyaḥ sūre na viśaḥ | apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyanvrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma ||
indurvājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya | hanti rakṣo bādhate paryarātiṃ varivaskṛṇvanvṛjanasya rājā ||
ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni māṃścatva indro sarasi pra dhanva | braghnaścidyasya vāto na jūtiṃ purumedhāścittakave naraṃ dhāt ||
mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārāpāṃ yadgarbho 'vṛṇīta devān | adadhādindre pavamāna ojo 'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ ||
asarji vakvā rathye yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamā manīṣa | daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye mṛjanti vahniṃ sadaneṣvaccha ||
apāmivedūrmayastartturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somamaccha | namasyantīrupa ca yanti saṃ cāca viśantyuśatīruśantam ||
purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave | apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam ||
ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati | patirviśvasya bhūmano vyakhyadrodasī ubhe ||
sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ | pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ ||
somāḥ pavanta indavo 'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ | mitrāḥ svānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
abhī no vājasātamaṃ rayimarṣa śataspṛham | indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhāsaham ||
abhī navante adruhaḥ priyamindrasya kāmyam | vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ ||
ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanuṣṭanvanti pauṃsyam | śukrā vi yantyasurāya nirṇije vipāmagre mahīyuvaḥ ||
pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa | yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati ||
pra sunvānāsyāndhaso marto na vaṣṭa tadvacaḥ | apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ ||
abhi priyāṇi pavate canohito nāmāni yahvo adhi yeṣu vardhate | ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhannadhi rathaṃ viṣvañcamaruhadvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
acodaso no dhanvantvindavaḥ pra svānāso bṛhaddeveṣu harayaḥ | vi cidaśnānā iṣayo arātayo 'ryo naḥ santu saniṣantu no dhiyaḥ ||
eṣa pra kośe madhumāṃ acikradadindrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭamaḥ | abhyR^ī3tasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payasā ca ghenavaḥ ||
pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṅgiram | marya iva yuvatibhiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmanā pathā ||
dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nṛbhiḥ | hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhirvṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇuṣe nadīṣvā ||
vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnāṃ pratarītoṣasāṃ divaḥ | prāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṃ acikradadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibhiḥ ||
trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhrire satyāmāśiraṃ parame vyomani | catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata ||
indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravāpāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha | mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santvindavaḥ ||
asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat | punāno vāramatyeṣyavyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantamāsadat ||
pra devamacchā madhumanta indavo 'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ | barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutamusriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire ||
añjate vyañjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti maghvābhyañjate | sindhoru 'cchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumapsu gṛbhṇate ||
pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ | ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantaḥ saṃ tadāśata ||
indramaccha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṃ yantu harayaḥ | śruṣṭe jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ ||
pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvirindrāyendo pari srava | dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bhara svarvidam ||
sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata | śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye ||
taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata | śiśuṃ na havyaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ ||
prāṇā śiśurmahīnāṃ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitim | viśvā pari priyā bhuvadadha dvitā ||
pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhirojasā | ā kalaśaṃ madhumāntsoma naḥ sadaḥ ||
somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyaṃ vāraṃ vi dhāvati | agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat ||
pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca ucyate | bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhirjujoṣate ||
gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dhaniva | śuciṃ ca varṇamadhi goṣu dhārya ||
asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidamabhi vāṇīranūṣata | gobhiṣṭe varṇamabhi vāsayāmasi ||
pavate haryato harirati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā | abhyarṣa stotṛbhyo vīravadyaśaḥ ||
pari kośaṃ madhuścutaṃ somaḥ punāno arṣati | abhi vāṇīrṛṣīṇāṃ saptā nūṣata ||
pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ | mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ ||
abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa iṣaspate didīhi deva devayum | vi kośaṃ madhyamaṃ yuva ||
ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomamapturaṃ rajasturam | vanaprakṣamudaprutam ||
etamu tyaṃ madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divoduham | viśvā vasūni bibhratam ||
sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḍānām | somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām ||
tvaṃ hyā3ṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ | amṛtatvāya ghoṣayan ||
eṣa sya dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ | krīḍannūrmirapāmiva ||

pra sunvānāyāndhaso martto na vaṣṭa tadvacaḥ | apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ ||
ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ | sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam ||
sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī | hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam ||
abhrātṛvyo anā tvamanāpirindra januṣā sanādasi | yudhedāpitvamicchase ||
na kī revantaṃ sakhyāya vindase pīyanti te surāśvaḥ | yadā kṛṇoṣi nadanuṃ samūhasyāditpiteva hūyase ||
ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye | brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye ||

agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
garbhe mātuḥ pituṣpitā vididyutāno akṣare | sīdannṛtasya yonimā ||
brahma prajāvadā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | agne yaddīdayaddivi ||
asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam | sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumanti hotā ||
bhadrā vastrā samanyā ' '3 vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan | ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau ||
samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme | abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
eto nvindraṃ stavāma śuddhaṃ śuddhena sāmnā | śuddhairukthairvāvṛdhvāṃsaṃ śuddhairāśīrvānmamattu ||
indra śuddho na ā gahi śuddhaḥ śuddhābhirūtibhiḥ | śuddho rayiṃ ni dhāraya śuddho mamaddhi somya ||
indra śuddho hi no rayiṃ śuddho ratnāni dāśuṣe | śuddho vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddho vājaṃ siṣāsasi ||
agne stomaṃ manāmahe sidhramadya divispṛśaḥ | devasya draviṇasyavaḥ ||
agnirjuṣata no giro hotā yo mānuṣeṣvā | sa yakṣaddaivyaṃ janam ||
tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ | tvayā yajñaṃ vi tanvate ||
abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgoṣiṇamavāvaśaṃta vāṇīḥ | vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūrvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi ||
śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvānjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni | tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḍhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn ||
urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā purandhī | apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ svā3rgāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān ||
tvamindra yaśā asyṛjīṣī śavasaspatiḥ | tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdhṛtiḥ ||
tamu tvā nūnamasura pracetasaṃ rādho bhāgamivemahe | mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan ||
yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam | asya yajñasya sukratum ||
apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditimagnimu śreṣṭhaśociṣam | sa no mitrasya varuṇasya so apāmā sumnaṃ yakṣate divi ||
yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ | sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ ||
na kirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit | vājo asti śravāyyaḥ ||
sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā | viprebhirastu sanitā ||
sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ | hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī ||
saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ | maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yantsaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ ||
uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ | mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ ||

pibā sutasya rasino matsvā na indra gomataḥ | āpirno bodhi sadhamādye vṛdhe3 'smāṃ avantu te dhiyaḥ || bhūyāma te sumatau vājino vayaṃ mā na starabhimātaye | asmāṃ citrābhiravatādabhiṣṭibhirā naḥ sumneṣu yāmaya ||
trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhrire satyāmāśiraṃ parame vyomani | catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata ||
sa bhakṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe | tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ ||
te asya santu ketavo 'mṛtyavo 'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu | yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata ||
abhi vāyuṃ vītyarṣā gṛṇāno3 'bhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ | abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum ||
abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣābhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ | abhi candrā bharttave no hiraṇyābhyaśvānrathino deva soma ||
abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ | abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmābhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ ||
yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya | tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uto divam ||
tatte yajño ajāyata tadarka uta haskṛtiḥ | tadviśvamabhibhūrasi yajjātaṃ yacca jantvam ||
āmāsu pakvamairaya ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi | gharmaṃ na sāmaṃ tapatā suvṛktibhirjuṣṭaṃ girvaṇase bṛhat ||
matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva harivo matsaro madaḥ | vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ ||
ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ | sahāvāṃ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanaṣāḍamartyaḥ ||
tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham | sahāvāndasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā ||
pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no 'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari | ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ ||
tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman | janyāsa upa no gṛham ||
ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ | asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava ||
sa na ūrje vyā3vyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā | devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam ||
pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat | pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ ||
pratyasmai pipīṣate viśvāni viduṣe bhara | araṅgamāya jagmaye 'paścādadhvane naraḥ ||
emenaṃ pratyetana somebhiḥ somapātamam | amatrebhirṛjīṣiṇamindraṃ sutebhirindubhiḥ ||
yadī sutebhirindubhiḥ somebhiḥ pratibhūṣatha | vedā viśvasya medhiro dhṛṣattantamideṣate ||
asmāasmā idandhaso 'dhvaryo pra bharā sutam | kuvitsamasya jenyasya śardhato 'bhiśasteravasvarat ||
babhrave nu svatavase 'ruṇāya divispṛśe | somāya gāthamarcata ||
hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana | madhāvā dhāvatā madhu ||
namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana | indumindre dadhātana ||
amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave | devebhyo anukāmakṛt ||
indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase | manaścinmanasaspatiḥ ||
pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ | indavindreṇa no yujā ||
uddhedabhi śrutāmaghaṃ vṛṣamaṃ naryāpasam | astārameṣi sūrya ||
nava yo navatiṃ puro bibheda bāhvojasā | ahiṃ ca vṛtrahāvadhīt ||
sa na indraḥ śivaḥ sakhāśvāvadgomadyavamat | urudhāreva dohate ||
vibhrāḍ bṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam | vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ piparti bahudhā vi rājati ||
vibhrāḍ bṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamaṃ dharmaṃ divo dharuṇe satyamarpitam | amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhantamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā ||
idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat | viśvabhrāḍ bhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam ||
indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā | śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīva jyotiraśīmahi ||
mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo3 māśivāso 'va kramuḥ | tvayā vayaṃ pravataḥ śaśvatīrapo 'ti śūra tarāmasi ||

uta naḥ priyā priyāsu saptasvasā sujuṣṭā | sarasvatī stomyā bhūt ||

agna āyūṃṣi pavase ā suvorjaṃ iṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
tā naḥ śaktaṃ pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya | mahi vā kṣatraṃ deveṣu ||
ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte | adruhā devau vardhete ||
vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ | bṛhantaṃ garttamāśāte ||
yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ | rocante rocanā divi ||
yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe | śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā ||
ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase | samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ ||
ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunve tubhyaṃ pavate tvamasya pāhi | tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam ||
sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḍayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni | ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta ||
śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ | āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ ||
tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hitaḥ | devebhirmānuṣe jane ||
sa no mandrābhiradhvare jihvābhiryajā mahaḥ | ā devānvakṣi yakṣi ca ||
vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaśca devāñjasā | agne yajñeṣu sukrato ||
hotā devo amartyaḥ purastādeti māyayā | vidathāni pracodayan ||
vājī vājeṣu dhīyate 'dhvareṣu pra ṇīyate | vipro yajñasya sādhanaḥ ||
dhiyā cakre vareṇyo bhūtānāṃ garbhamā dadhe | dakṣasya pitaraṃ tanā ||
ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam | rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||
te jānata svamokyā3ṃ saṃ vatsāso na mātṛbhiḥ | mitho nasanta jāmibhiḥ ||
upa srakveṣu bapsataḥ kṛṇvate dharuṇaṃ divi | indre agnā namaḥ svaḥ ||
tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭaṃ yato jajñā ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ | sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ ||
vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti | avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ | svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiraṃ tuviśuṣmastṛmpatsomamapibadviṣṇunā sutaṃ yathāvaśam | sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma kartave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram ||
sākaṃ jātaḥ kratunā sākamojasā vavakṣitha sākaṃ vṛddho vīryaiḥ sāsahirmṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ | dātā rādha stuvate kāmyaṃ vasu pracetana sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram ||
adha tviṣīmāṃ abhyojasā kṛviṃ yudhābhavadā rodasī apṛṇadasya majmanā pra vāvṛdhe | adhattānyaṃ jaṭhare premaricyata pra cetaya sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram ||
abhi pra gopatiṃ girendramarca yathā vide | mūnuṃ satyasya satpatim ||
ā harayaḥ sasṛjrire 'ruṣīradhi barhiṣi | yatrābhi saṃnavāmahe ||
indrāya gāva āśiraṃ duduhre vajriṇe madhu | yatsīmupahvare vidat ||
ā no viśvāsu havyamindraṃ samatsu bhūṣata | upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahanparamajyā ṛcīṣama ||
tvaṃ dātā prathamo rādhasāmasyasi satya īśānakṛt | tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ ||
pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvyaṃ yadukthyaṃ maho gāhaddiva ā niradhukṣata | indramabhi jāyamānaṃ samasvaran ||
ādīṃ ke citpaśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abhyanūṣata | divo na vāraṃ savitā vyūrṇute ||
adha yadime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā | yūthe na niṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi rājasi ||
imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam | agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ ||
vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhorūrmā upāka ā | sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi ||
ā no bhaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madhyameṣu | śikṣā vasvo antamasya ||
ahamiddhi pituṣpari medhāmṛtasya jagraha | ahaṃ sūrya ivājani ||
ahaṃ pratnena janmanā giraḥ śumbhāmi kaṇvavat | yenendraḥ śuṣmamiddadhe ||
ye tvāmindra na tuṣṭuvurṛṣayo ye ca tuṣṭuvuḥ | mamedvardhasva suṣṭutaḥ ||
agne viśvebhiragnibhirjoṣi brahma sahaskṛta | ye devatrā ya āyuṣu tebhirno mahayā giraḥ ||
pra sa viśvebhiragnibhiragniḥ sa yasya vājinaḥ | tanaye toke asmadā samyaṅvājaiḥ parīvṛtaḥ ||
tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya | tvaṃ no devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya ||

tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ | divīva cakṣurātatam ||
tadviprāso vipanyuvo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate | viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ||
ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame | pṛthivyā adhi sānavi ||
mo ṣu tvā vāghataśca nāre asmanni rīraman | ārāttādva sadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi ||
ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate | indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādamā dadhuḥ ||
astāvi manma pūrvyaṃ brahmendrāya vocata | pūrvīrṛtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmedhā asṛkṣata ||
samindro rāyo bṛhatīradhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam | saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ ||
indrāya soma pātave vṛtraghne pari ṣicyase |
nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade || taṃ sakhāyaḥ purūrucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ | aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam ||
pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa | yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati ||
kastamindra tvāvaso martyo dadharṣati | śraddhā ittemaghavan pārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati ||
maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu | tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhirviśvā tarema duritā ||
edu madhormadintaraṃ siñcādhvaryo andhasaḥ | evā hi vīra stavate sadāvṛdhaḥ ||
indra sthātarharīṇāṃ na kiṣṭe pūrvyastutim | udānaṃśa śavasā na bhandanā ||
taṃ vo vājānāṃ patimahūmahi śravasyavaḥ | aprāyubhirjñebhirvāvṛdhenyam ||
taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire | devatrā havyamūhiṣe ||
vibhūtarātiṃ vipra citraśociṣamagnimīḍiṣva yanturam | asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarāya pūrvyam ||
ā soma savāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā | jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhriṣe ||
sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḍvāntsaptirna vājayuḥ | anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhirṛkvabhiḥ ||
vayamenamidā hyo 'pīpemeha vajriṇam | tasmā u adya savane sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute ||
vṛkaścidasya vāraṇa urāmathirā vayuneṣu bhūṣati | semaṃ na stomaṃ jujuṣāṇa ā gahīndra pra citrayā dhiyā ||
indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ | tadvāṃ ceti pra vīryam ||
indrāgnī apasaspari upa pra yanti dhītayaḥ | ṛtasya pathyā anu ||
indrāgnī taviṣāṇi vām sadhasthāni prayāṃsi ca | yuvoraptūryaṃ hitam ||
ka īṃ veda sute sacā pibantaṃ kadvayo dadhe | ayaṃ yaḥ puro vibhinattyojasā mandānaḥ śiprayandhasaḥ ||
dānā mṛgo na vāraṇaḥ purutrā carathaṃ dadhe | na kiṣṭvā ni yamadā sute gamo mahāṃścarasyojasā ||
ya ugraḥ sannaniṣṭṛtaḥ sthiro raṇāya saṃskṛtaḥ | yadi stoturmaghavā śṛṇavaddhavaṃ nendro yoṣatyā gamat ||

pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgramindavaḥ | ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ ||
tośā vṛtrahaṇā huve sajitvānāparājitā | indrāgnī vājasātamā ||
pra vāmarcantyukthino nīthāvido jaritāraḥ | indrāgnī iṣa ā vṛṇe ||
indrāgnī navatiṃ puro dāsapatnīradhūnutam | sākamekena karmaṇā ||

upa cchāyāmiva ghṛṇeraganma śarma te vayam | agne hiraṇyasandṛśaḥ ||
ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṃsagaḥ | agne puro rurojitha ||
ṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaramṛtasya jyotiṣaspatim | ajasraṃ gharmamīmahe ||
ya idaṃ pratipaprathe yajñasya svaruttiran | ṛtūnutsṛjate vaśī ||
agniḥ priyeṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya | sabhrāḍeko vi rājati ||
agniḥ pratnena janmanā śumbhānastanvā3ṃ svām | kavirvipreṇa vavṛdhe ||
ūrjjo napātamā huve 'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam | asminyajñe svadhvare ||
sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā | devairā satsi barhiṣi ||
utte śuṣmāso asthū rakṣo bhindanto adrivaḥ | nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ ||
ayā nijaghnirojasā rathasaṅge dhane hite | stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā ||
asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā | ruja yastvā pṛtanyati ||
taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam | indumindrāya matsaram ||
ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ | mā tvā ke cinni yemurinna pāśino 'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi ||
vṛtrakhādo valaṃ rujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ | sthātā rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dṛḍhā cidārujaḥ ||
gambhīrāṃ udadhīṃriva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva | pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata ||
yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyannetyaveriṇam | āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba ||
mandantu tvā maghavannindrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate | āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ taddadhiṣe sahaḥ ||
tvamaṅga pra śuṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||
mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso 'smānkadā canā dabhan | viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā ||
prati ṣyā sūnarī janī vyucchantī pari svasuḥ | divo adarśi duhitā ||
aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmṛtāvarī | sakhā bhūdaśvinoruṣāḥ ||
uta sakhāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi | utoṣo vasva īśiṣe ||
eṣo uṣā apūrvya vyucchati priyā divaḥ | stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat ||
yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām | dhiyā devā vasuvidā ||
vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadhi viṣṭapi | yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt ||
uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati | yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibhāvari | revadasme vyuccha sūnṛtāvati ||
yuṅkṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvāṃ adyāruṇāṃ uṣaḥ | athā no viśvā saubhagānyā vaha ||
aśvinā vartirasmadā gomaddasrā hiraṇyavat | arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam ||
eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavarttanī | uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye ||
yāvitthā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakrathuḥ | ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam ||
agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ | astamarvanta āśavostaṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
agnirhi vājinaṃ viśe dadāti viśvacarṣaṇiḥ | agnī rāye svābhuvaṃ sa prīto yāti vāryamiṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
so agniryo vasurgṛṇe saṃ yamāyanti dhenavaḥ | samarvanto raghudruvaḥ saṃ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī | yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
yā sunīthe śaucadrathe vyauccho duhitardivaḥ | sā vyuccha sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
sā no adyābharadvasurvyucchā duhitardivaḥ | yo vyaucchaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi yāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte ||
prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛśaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam | stotā vāmaśvināvṛṣi stomebhirbhūṣati prati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
atyāyātamaśvinā tiro viśvā ahaṃ sanā | dasrā hiraṇyavarttanī suṣumṇā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
ā no ratnāni bibhratāvaśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam | rudrā hiraṇyavarttanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam | yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sasrate nākamaccha ||
abodhi hotā yajathāya devānūrdhvo agniḥ sumanāḥ prātarasthāt | samiddhasya ruśadadarśi pājo mahāndevastamaso niramoci ||
yadīṃ gaṇasya raśanāmajīgaḥ śuciraṅkte śucibhirgobhiragniḥ | āddakṣiṇā yujyate vājayantyuttānāmūrdhvo adhayajjuhūbhiḥ ||
idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirāgāccitraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibhvā | yathā prasūtā savituḥ savāyaivā rātryuṣase yonimāraik ||
ruśādvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgādāraigu kṛṣṇā sadanānyasyāḥ | samānabandhū amṛte anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne ||
samāno adhvā svasroranantastamanyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe | na methete na tasthatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe ||
ā bhātyagniruṣasāmanīkamudviprāṇāṃ devayā vāco asthuḥ | arvāñcā nūnaṃ rathyeha yātaṃ pīpivāṃsamaśvinā gharmamaccha ||
na saṃskṛtaṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭhānti nūnamaśvinopastuteha | divābhipitvevasāgamiṣṭhā pratyavarttiṃ dāśuṣe śambhaviṣṭhā ||
utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātarahno madhyandina uditā sūryasya | divā naktamavasā śantamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna ||
etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānumañjate | niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo 'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ ||
udapaptannaruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata | akrannuṣāso vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantaṃ bhānumaruṣīraśiśrayuḥ ||
arcanti nārīrapaso na viṣṭibhiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ | iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukṛte sudānave viśvedaha yajamānāya sunvate ||
abodhyagnirjma udeti sūryo vyū3ṣāścandrā mahyāvo arciṣā | āyukṣātāmaśvinā yātave rathaṃ prāsāvīddevaḥ savitā jagatpṛthak ||
yadyuñjāthe vṛṣaṇamaśvinā rathaṃ ghṛtena no madhunā kṣatramukṣatam | asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu jinvataṃ vayaṃ dhanā śūrasātā bhajemahi ||
arvāṅtricakro madhuvāhano ratho jīrāśvo aśvinoryātu suṣṭutaḥ | trivandhuro maghavā viśvasaubhagaḥ śaṃ na ā vakṣaddvipade catuṣpade ||
pra te dhārā asaścato divo na yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ | acchā vājaṃ sahasriṇam ||
abhi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati | haristuñjāna āyudhā ||
sa marmṛjāna āyubhiribho rājeva suvrataḥ | śyeno na vaṃsu ṣīdati ||
sa no viśvā divo vasūto pṛthivyā adhi | punāna indavā bhara ||
prāsya dhārā akṣaranvṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā | devāṃ anu prabhūṣataḥ ||
saptiṃ mṛjanti vedhaso gṛṇantaḥ kāravo girā | jyotirjajñānamukthyam ||
suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabhūvaso | vardhā samudramukthyam ||
eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviya indro nāma śruto gṛṇe ||
tvāmicchavasaspate yanti giro na saṃyataḥ ||
vi srutayo yathā pathā indra tvadyantu rātayaḥ ||
ā tvā rathaṃ yathotaye sumnāya varttayāmasi | tuvikūrmimṛtīṣahamindraṃ śaviṣṭha satpatim ||
tuviśuṣma tuvikrato śacīvo viśvayā mate | ā paprātha mahitvanā ||
yasya te mahinā mahaḥ pari jmāyantamīyatuḥ | hastā vajraṃ hiraṇyayam ||
ā yaḥ puraṃ nārmiṇīmadīdedatyaḥ kavirnabhanyo3 nārva | sūro na rurukvāñchatātmā ||
abhi dvijanmā trī rocanāni viśvā rajāṃsi śuśucano asthāt | hotā yajiṣṭho apāṃ sadhasthe ||
ayaṃ sa hotā yo dvijanmā viśvā dadhe vāryāṇi śravasyā | marto yo asmai sutuko dadāśa ||
agne tamadyāṣvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛṣam | ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ ||
adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ | rathīrṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha ||
ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅksvā3rṇa jyotiḥ | agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ ||
agne vivasvaduṣasaścitraṃ rādho amartya | ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ ||
juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano 'gne rathīradhvarāṇām | sajūraśvibhyāmuṣasā suvīryamasme dhehi śravo bṛhat ||
vidhuṃ dadrāṇaṃ samane bahūnāṃ yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra | devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ samāna ||
śākmanā śāko aruṇaḥ suparṇa ā yo mahaḥ śūraḥ sanādanīḍaḥ | yacciketa satyamittanna moghaṃ vasu spārhamuta jetota dātā ||
aibhirdade vṛṣṇyā pauṃsyāni yebhiraukṣadvṛtrahatyāya vajrī | ye karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya mahna ṛtekarmamudajāyanta devāḥ ||
asti somo ayaṃ sutaḥ pibantyasya marutaḥ | uta svarājo aśvinā ||
pibanti mitro aryamā tanā pūtasya varuṇaḥ | triṣadhasthasya jāvataḥ ||
uto nvasya joṣamā indraḥ sutasya gomataḥ | prātarhoteva matsati ||
baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ asi | mahaste sato mahimā paniṣtama mahnā deva mahāṃ asi ||
baṭ sūrya śravasā mahāṃ asi satrā deva mahāṃ asi | mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam ||
upa no haribhiḥ sutaṃ yāhi madānāṃ pate | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
dvitā yo vṛtrahantamo vida indraḥ śatakratuḥ | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
tvaṃ hi vṛtrahanneṣāṃ pātā somānāmasi | upa no haribhiḥ sutam ||
pra vo mahe mahevṛdhe bharadhvaṃ pracetase pra sumatiṃ kṛṇudhvam | viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra cara carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
uruvyacase mahine suvṛktimindrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ | tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ ||
indraṃ vāṇīranuttamanyumeva satrā rājānaṃ dadhire sahadhyai | haryaśvāya barhayā samāpīn ||
yadindra yāvatastvametāvadahamīśīya | stotāramiddadhiṣe radāvaso na pāpatvāya raṃsiṣam ||
śikṣeyaminmahayate divedive rāya ā kuhacidvide | na hi tvadanyanmaghavanna āpyaṃ vasyo asti pitā ca na ||
śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrerbodhā viprasyārcato manīṣām | kṛṣvā duvāṃsyantamā sacemā ||
na te giro api mṛṣye turasya na suṣṭutimasuryasya vidvān | sadā te nāma svayaśo vivakmi ||
bhūri hi te savanā mānuṣeṣu bhūri manīṣī havate tvāmit | māre asmanmaghavañjyokkaḥ ||
pro ṣvasmai purorathamindrāya śūṣamarcata | abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṅge samatsu vṛtraha | asmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
tvaṃ sindhūṃravāsṛjo 'dharāco ahannahim | aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryam | taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
vi ṣu viśvā arātayo 'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ | astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati | yā te rātirdadivasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||
revāṃ idrevata stotā syāttvāvato maghonaḥ | predu harivaḥ sutasya ||
ukthaṃ ca na śasyamānaṃ nāgo rayirā ciketa | na gāyatraṃ gīyamānam ||
mā na indra pīyatnave mā śardhate parā dāḥ | śikṣā śacīvaḥ śacībhiḥ ||
endra yāhi haribhirupa kaṇvasya suṣṭutim | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
atrā vi nemireṣāmurāṃ na dhūnute vṛkaḥ | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
ā tvā grāvā vadanīha somī ghoṣeṇa vakṣatu | divo amuṣya śāsato divaṃ yaya divāvaso ||
pavasva soma mandayannindrāya madhumattamaḥ ||
te sutāso vipaścitaḥ śukrā vāyumasṛkṣata ||
asṛgraṃ devavītaye vājayanto rathā iva ||
agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasoḥ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam ya ūrdhvaro svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā | ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ ||
yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭhamaṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhirviprebhiḥ śukramanmabhiḥ | parijmānamiva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām | śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yamimā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ ||
sa hi purū cidojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhantaraḥ paraśurna druhantaraḥ | vīḍu cidyasya samṛtau śruvadvaneva yatsthiram | niṣṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate ||
agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso | bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthya3ṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||
pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā | putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||
ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ | tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ ||
irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya | sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi darśataṃ kratum ||
iṣkarttāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ | rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim ||
ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ | śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā ||
